questions.question: Eight boys, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are seated around a round table, not necessarily in same order, but with equal spacing between them and all facing the centre of the table. S is seated exactly opposite to P, who has U and R as his immediate neighbours. T is seated immediately next to V, who is to the immediate right of S. Q is exactly opposite to T and does not have R as his immediate neighbour. With this information, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: R is seated exactly opposite to W
S and U are the immediate neighbours of W.
Q and U are not the neighbours of each other.
T is seated immediately next to V but not next to R.

questions.solution:
Given :

 
• Eight boys - P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W
 
• They are seated around a round table but with equal spacing between them
 
• All are facing the center of the table.

​Explanation :

1) S is seated exactly opposite to P, who has U and R as his immediate neighbours. 

As position of U and R with respect to P is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2758dd4d57ebb63e10f6938449959dad6b6fe9b208e411fa42d71b06c38195e6.png] 

 
• Case - (2)​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e622990b240b082e4124922001f12f238cbd32e865356300a0b0fe78ce472df.png] 

2) T is seated immediately next to V, who is to the immediate right of S. 

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/471129961817f2841dc23a4882347b3490ef65abec603777a4a0524173d440bc.png] 

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7aa3367409e675666509640bece0fdda0e3db2f8a7b59c0e7e7aaa457f0bd66.png] 

3) Q is exactly opposite to T and does not have R as his immediate neighbor.

As in case - (2) there is no possible position for Q, therefore this case is eliminated.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0025baf720ef1d92a2cde58a5d8aea7b19423e6efde21c4ed84587b7ebfa4dca.png] 

**Thus, according to the final arrangement:**

 
• R is seated exactly opposite to W - **Correct**
 
• S and U are the immediate neighbors of W - Incorrect (As S and Q are immediate neighbors of W)
 
• Q and U are not the neighbors of each other - Incorrect (AS Q and U are neighbors of each other)
 
• T is seated immediately next to V but not next to R - Incorrect ( As T is seated immediate next to both V and R)

Hence, **"****R is seated exactly opposite to W"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

7 : 9 :: 8 : ? :: 6 : 2
questions.solution:
**Logic : [Cube of (First number - 5)] + 1 = Second number**

So,

 
• 7 : 9

(7 - 5)³ + 1 = 9

(2)³ + 1 = 9

8 + 1 = 9

9 = 9 (LHS = RHS)

 
• 6 : 2

(6 - 5)³ + 1 = 2

(1)³ + 1 = 2

1 + 1 = 2

2 = 2 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly, 

 
• 8 : ?

(8 - 5)³ + 1 = ?

(3)³ + 1 = ?

27 + 1 = ?

**? = 28**

Hence, **"28"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully, Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All burgers are cakes.

Some sweets are fruits.

All sweets are burgers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some fruits are burgers.

II. Some cakes are sweets.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a1563f797d3eed4780a5c8b36d119fc45ac854b5d4078bacd95b0e10cc5c413.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some fruits are burgers → Follow (As some sweets are fruits, all sweets are burgers. So, it is definitely true)

II. Some cakes are sweets → **F**ollow (As all burgers are cakes, all sweets are burgers. So, it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Both the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both the conclusions follow**".
